This capability is honest about what it withholds (no plan id/identifier/name echo) rather than lying about it, so it does NOT repeat the clone_exploratory_session_v1 defect (that one falsely UNDERREPORTED what it had copied in its own response body; this one truthfully reports nothing at all about the new plan). RUN-LINKAGE DEFECT — CONFIRMED SYSTEMIC, NOT TR-9061-SPECIFIC: get_test_runs_v1(project_id=379335744, include_test_plan='true') was read for BOTH runs. TR-9061 (the untouched source run) still shows test_plans:[] with metadata.test_plan_error='PLAN_LINKED' (unchanged from the prior open finding). TR-9111 (the brand-new run this very clone just created and linked to plan 48319, independently confirmed linked via get_test_plan_test_runs_v1) ALSO shows test_plans:[] on the same get_test_runs_v1 listing, but with metadata:null (no test_plan_error flag at all, unlike TR-9061). So the 'test_plans always empty despite a genuine link' defect reproduces on a run that is seconds old with no caching history to blame, ruling out staleness as the explanation — this is a second, independent, freshly-minted confirmation that get_test_runs_v1 (and include_test_plan=true) cannot surface plan linkage for ANY run, old or new. The metadata field itself is inconsistent between the two runs (present with an error code on TR-9061, entirely null on TR-9111) which is a secondary curiosity but the core defect — test_plans:[] despite confirmed linkage — is the same on both.
